key_findings: Ablation or silencing of AAV-NpyP+ SDH inhibitory interneurons converts Abeta fiber signals into morphine-resistant pain-like behavior.
After nerve injury these neurons are hypoexcitable; chemogenetic activation reverses Abeta-derived allodynia.
